COMBAT ROBOTICS

Building a combat robot

Hands-on work with motors, wiring, and a compact robotic platform.

I worked on a combat robot, including the hands-on motor and wiring work that goes into bringing the robot together. The build gave me another way to work with the connection between the mechanical layout and the electrical system.

These photos show the robot with its internal components exposed, the assembled chassis, and the motor connections I worked on. The video captures the robot during the build and testing process.
